<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation
Follow PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28403. Support DP/DP attention for it.

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
- Remove the startup rejection for system DP and DP attention. Continue rejecting DP attention local control broadcast, EP, PP, MoE all-to-all, and DCP configurations that remain unsupported.
- Add an internal `prepare_only` request flag. The scheduler performs the existing eligibility, idle-state and decode CUDA graph memory checks, then returns readiness without releasing resources or changing roles.
- For multiple DP workers, the tokenizer sends a shallow copy of the request with `prepare_only=True`, collects all expected DP worker responses, and sends the actual switch only if all are ready. Empty response sets are treated as failure, and a prepare request does not update the tokenizer's role.
- Add unit coverage for startup validation, non-destructive preflight, busy workers, insufficient graph headroom, and successful switching for both system DP and attention DP.

Staging-buffer compatibility and new PP support are outside its scope.
## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->
Full GSM8K evaluation with **prefill CUDA graphs disabled on both instances from startup** (`--disable-prefill-cuda-graph`). Decode CUDA graphs remain enabled. The GPU accuracy results below cover **Qwen3.5-0.8B with attention DP** under this configuration.
Every phase evaluates all **1,319 test examples**. The first five training examples are used as few-shot demonstrations; no test example is used as a demonstration.

Model: Qwen3.5-0.8B, real local weights.
Parallelism: `--tp-size 2 --attn-dp-size 2` per instance, system DP size 1 and attention TP size 1. Two instances use four NVIDIA A10 GPUs on an eight-GPU host.
| Phase | Correct / total | Accuracy |
|---|---:|---:|
| Initial P/D | 412/1319 | 31.24% |
| P/D roles exchanged | 418/1319 | 31.69% |
| Original roles restored | 413/1319 | 31.31% |
## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->
Measured role-switch HTTP latency with no generation requests in flight:

| Exchange | Instance | Transition | Latency (s) |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| 1 | 0 | prefill → decode | 1.152 |
| 1 | 1 | decode → prefill | 0.402 |
| 2 | 0 | decode → prefill | 0.493 |
| 2 | 1 | prefill → decode | 0.420 |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).

- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+class TestDPRoleSwitch(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
+    async def test_all_workers_must_be_ready_before_switching(self):
+        for dp_size, attn_dp_size in ((2, 1), (1, 2)):
+            with self.subTest(dp_size=dp_size, attn_dp_size=attn_dp_size):

+    async def test_insufficient_headroom_prevents_switching_all_workers(self):
+        for dp_size, attn_dp_size in ((2, 1), (1, 2)):
+            with self.subTest(dp_size=dp_size, attn_dp_size=attn_dp_size):
+                await self._check_preflight(
+                    dp_size, attn_dp_size, insufficient_memory=True
+                )
+
+    async def _check_preflight(self, dp_size, attn_dp_size, insufficient_memory=False):
+        from sglang.srt.managers import tokenizer_control_mixin as control
+
+        fixture = TestHandlePdRoleSwitch()
+        fixture.setUp()
+        self.addCleanup(fixture.tearDown)
+        self.addCleanup(fixture.doCleanups)
+        schedulers = [fixture._scheduler(DisaggregationMode.PREFILL) for _ in range(2)]
+        available_memory = [2.0, 2.0]
+        for scheduler in schedulers:
+            scheduler.device = "cuda"
+            scheduler.tp_worker.get_decode_cuda_graph_bs.return_value = (
+                [] if insufficient_memory else [1]
+            )
+            scheduler.init_disaggregation.side_effect = lambda s=scheduler: setattr(
+                s,
+                "disaggregation_mode",
+                DisaggregationMode(rc.get_disagg().disaggregation_mode),
+            )
+
+        async def fanout(req):
+            results = []
+            for index, scheduler in enumerate(schedulers):
+                rc.get_context().set_server_args(scheduler.server_args)
+                rc.get_context().override(
+                    "test.role", disaggregation_mode=scheduler.disaggregation_mode.value
+                )
+                with patch.object(
+                    role_switch,
+                    "get_available_gpu_memory",
+                    return_value=available_memory[index],
+                ):
+                    results.append(role_switch.handle_pd_role_switch(scheduler, req))
+            if req.prepare_only:
+                for scheduler in schedulers:
+                    scheduler.init_disaggregation.assert_not_called()
+            return results
+
+        manager = SimpleNamespace(
+            server_args=SimpleNamespace(enable_pd_role_switch=True),
+            auto_create_handle_loop=MagicMock(),
+            pd_role_switch_communicator=AsyncMock(side_effect=fanout),
+            record_config_updates=MagicMock(),
+            disaggregation_mode=DisaggregationMode.PREFILL,
+        )
+        req = PdRoleSwitchReqInput(
+            new_role="decode",
+            decode_cuda_graph_memory_gb=1.0 if insufficient_memory else None,
+        )
+        with patch.object(
+            control,
+            "get_parallel",
+            return_value=SimpleNamespace(
+                dp_size=dp_size,
+                attn_dp_size=attn_dp_size,
+                num_dp_ranks=dp_size * attn_dp_size,
+            ),
+        ):
+            if insufficient_memory:
+                available_memory[1] = 0.5
+            else:
+                schedulers[1].is_fully_idle.return_value = False
+            out = await control.TokenizerControlMixin.pd_role_switch(manager, req)
+            self.assertFalse(out.success)
+            self.assertTrue(out.safe_to_restore)
+            self.assertIn(
+                "insufficient" if insufficient_memory else "not idle", out.message
+            )
+            manager.pd_role_switch_communicator.assert_awaited_once()
+            self.assertTrue(
+                manager.pd_role_switch_communicator.call_args.args[0].prepare_only
+            )
+            manager.record_config_updates.assert_not_called()
+            for scheduler in schedulers:
+                scheduler.init_disaggregation.assert_not_called()
+                scheduler.teardown_disaggregation.assert_not_called()
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    scheduler.disaggregation_mode, DisaggregationMode.PREFILL
+                )
+
+            available_memory[1] = 2.0
+            schedulers[1].is_fully_idle.return_value = True
+            out = await control.TokenizerControlMixin.pd_role_switch(manager, req)
+            self.assertTrue(out.success)
+            self.assertEqual(manager.disaggregation_mode, DisaggregationMode.DECODE)
+            for scheduler in schedulers:
+                scheduler.init_disaggregation.assert_called_once()
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    scheduler.disaggregation_mode, DisaggregationMode.DECODE
+                )
